TABLE.NAME: local_oksigeniamarandu_contact
TABLE.COMMENT: One WhatsApp number and its consent

FIELD.NAME: phone
FIELD.COMMENT: Country code and number, digits only

FIELD.NAME: name
FIELD.COMMENT: Profile name WhatsApp sent, if any

FIELD.NAME: lang
FIELD.COMMENT: Language for the messages; empty means the site language

FIELD.NAME: status
FIELD.COMMENT: pending, active or optedout

FIELD.NAME: consenttime
FIELD.COMMENT: When the last opt-in happened

FIELD.NAME: consentsource
FIELD.COMMENT: How the last opt-in happened: keyword, page or admin

FIELD.NAME: optouttime
FIELD.COMMENT: When the last opt-out happened

FIELD.NAME: lastinbound
FIELD.COMMENT: Last message from this number: opens the 24-hour window

TABLE.NAME: local_oksigeniamarandu_link
TABLE.COMMENT: Whom a contact stands for: a Moodle user or an item of another plugin, with the code that claims it

FIELD.NAME: contactid
FIELD.COMMENT: Empty until somebody writes the code

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: Moodle user, if the link is for one

FIELD.NAME: component
FIELD.COMMENT: Plugin that asked for the link

FIELD.NAME: itemid
FIELD.COMMENT: Item of that plugin, such as a family

FIELD.NAME: code
FIELD.COMMENT: Code the family writes after the opt-in keyword

TABLE.NAME: local_oksigeniamarandu_consent
TABLE.COMMENT: Every opt-in and opt-out, kept as proof

FIELD.NAME: action
FIELD.COMMENT: optin or optout

FIELD.NAME: source
FIELD.COMMENT: keyword, page or admin

FIELD.NAME: detail
FIELD.COMMENT: Id of the WhatsApp message or who did it

TABLE.NAME: local_oksigeniamarandu_tpl
TABLE.COMMENT: The WhatsApp template of each notice in each language, and what Meta says of it

FIELD.NAME: component
FIELD.COMMENT: Plugin that declares the notice

FIELD.NAME: notice
FIELD.COMMENT: Notice, as the plugin names it

FIELD.NAME: lang
FIELD.COMMENT: Moodle language of the text

FIELD.NAME: name
FIELD.COMMENT: Name of the template in Meta

FIELD.NAME: metaid
FIELD.COMMENT: Id Meta gave to the template

FIELD.NAME: status
FIELD.COMMENT: pending, approved, rejected, paused or disabled, as Meta says

FIELD.NAME: category
FIELD.COMMENT: utility or marketing, as Meta says

FIELD.NAME: reason
FIELD.COMMENT: Why Meta rejected it, if it did

FIELD.NAME: body
FIELD.COMMENT: The text sent to Meta

TABLE.NAME: local_oksigeniamarandu_queue
TABLE.COMMENT: Every notice for every number: waiting, sent, delivered or not

FIELD.NAME: params
FIELD.COMMENT: Values of the template, JSON

FIELD.NAME: url
FIELD.COMMENT: Where the button of the notice goes, on this site

FIELD.NAME: token
FIELD.COMMENT: The end of the link of the button

FIELD.NAME: status
FIELD.COMMENT: queued, sent, delivered, read, failed or expired

FIELD.NAME: kind
FIELD.COMMENT: template, paid; text, free inside the 24 hours

FIELD.NAME: wamid
FIELD.COMMENT: Id Meta gave to the message

FIELD.NAME: errorcode
FIELD.COMMENT: Error code of Meta, to tell the reason in plain words

FIELD.NAME: attempts
FIELD.COMMENT: Tries after errors that pass

FIELD.NAME: timeretry
FIELD.COMMENT: Not before this time, after an error that passes

FIELD.NAME: timesent
FIELD.COMMENT: When it went out, or when it failed
